headline: THE OPERATIVE BASELINE. Captured under the pinned instrument with the generated harness enforcing it, reproduced exactly across two cycles and again under spec v2.

instrument.capturedUnder: spec v1 (3015b230...); RE-CAPTURED under the added-pins spec (135385ff...) with identical results at all six poses, which is how the added pins were shown to have been at their pinned values during the original capture. The later specId bump to v2 changed no pinned value.
instrument.enforcement: The generated harness ran immediately before each capture, including a caller-supplied renderable-mesh count, and returned the spec hash.

rebaselineResultsRelationship.finding: ITS RAYTRACING-OFF COLUMN IS NUMERICALLY IDENTICAL TO THIS BASELINE AT ALL SIX POSES, ratio and hue spread alike — 1.040478, 1.019942, 1.023193, 1.002152, 1.020074, 0.942736 and 0.015976, 0.025771, 0.020598, 0.025470, 0.022754, 0.033819.
rebaselineResultsRelationship.why_it_matters: That is a CROSS-TASK, CROSS-REBUILD, EXACT reproduction: a different task, a different scene construction, a different day, the same numbers. It is the strongest stability evidence this goal holds and it was previously unstated.
rebaselineResultsRelationship.itsOpenQuestionsAreNowAnswered: That record listed five hypotheses as still open. T012 answers them: four are rejected with measurements and the fifth, scene residency, is confirmed as the cause.
